spans.s:
m. (-श्मः)
1 A mountain, a rock.
2 A cloud, (in the language of the Vedas): see अश्मन्.

mfn. (-श्मः-श्मा-श्मं)
Stony, made of stone, &c.
E.
अश्मन् stone, and अण् affix: with the final rejected.

m. (-ट्टः-ट्टा-ट्टं)
Who or what breaks with a stone.
2 Bruised or broken by stones.
E.
अश्म and कुट्ठ what bruises or breaks.

mfn. (-कः-का-क्रं)
Breaking or bruising any thing with a stone.
E.
अश्म and कुदृक who breaks.

m. (-र्भः)
An emerald.
E.
अश्मन् a stone, and गर्भ the womb; the primary stone.

n. (-जं)
An emerald.
E.
अश्म and गर्म्भ before ज produced.

n. (-जं)
1 Red chalk.
2 Iron.
E.
अश्मन् a stone, &c. and ज produced.

n. (-कं)
Bitumen.
E.
अश्म and जतुक lac.

m. (-णः)
An axe or crow for breaking stones, &c.
n. (-णं)
Splitting stones or rocks.
E.
अश्मन् a stone, &c. द to split, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-श्मा)
A stone or rock.
E.
अश to spread, &c. मनिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Unbounded, unlimited.
2 Inauspicious, unlucky.
n. (-न्तं)
1 A fire-place.
2

Death.
3

A field, a plain.
E.
अश्मन् a stone, &c. and अन्त the end; it is also written अश्वन्त and अस्मन्त.

n. (-न्तं)
A furnace or fire-place: see अश्मन्त.

n. (-कं)
1 A fire-place.
2 A shade for a lamp.
3 A species of oxalis.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A plant, from the fibres of which the girdle of a Brahman may be made; also अश्मन्तक.

n. (-ष्पं)
Benzoin, (Styrax benzoin.)
E.
अश्मन् a stone, and षुष्प a flower: supposed to exude from rocks.

m. (-लः)
A mortar of stone or iron.
E.
अश्मन् a stone, and भाल the skull.

m. (-द्)
The name of a plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides, Rox.)
E.
अश्मन a stone, and भिद् what breaks.

m. (-दः)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, अश्मन् and भेद.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made or consisting of stone, stony.
n. (-यं)
A mineral.
E.
अश्म and मयट् aff.

m. (-निः)
An emerald.
E.
see अश्मगर्भ.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Stony, rocky, appertaining to stone or rock.
E.
अश्मन् and र aff.

Strangury.
2

Stone or gravel, (the disease.)
E.
अश्मर stony, and ङीप् fem. aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
A tree, (Tapia cratoeva.)
E.
अश्मरी gravel, and घ्न what destroys; a lithonthriptic.

m. (-रः)
A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
E.
see the last word, हर from हृ to carry away.

mn. (-रः-रं)
Iron.
E.
अश्मन् a stone, and सार essence, &c. the hardest stone, &c.

mn. (-रः-रं)
Stone or gravel, (the disease.)
E.
अश्मन् a stone, ईर aff.

First person pronoun, (अहं)
I.
(आवां)
We two.
(वयं)
We.
E.
अस to be, and मदिक् Uṇādi affix: the inflexions of this pronoun are very irregular.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Our, ours.
E.
अस्मद् I, and छ affix in the sense of the second case plur.

n. (-णं)
Forgetfulness, forgetting.
E.
अ neg. स्मरण remembering.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be recollected.
E.
अ neg. स्मरणीय to be remembered.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ती-र्त्तं)
1 Immemorial, not within memory.
2 Illegal, not according to law.
3 Not belonging to the Hindu institutes.
E.
अ neg. स्मार्त्त relating to law, &c. from स्मृति with अण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Forgotten.
E.
अ neg. स्मृत remembered.

f. (-तिः)
1 Want of memory, forgetfulness.
2 Not being part of the institutes.
E.
अ neg. स्मृति memory or code of law.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Made of stone, stony, stone.
E.
अश्मन् and अञ aff.
m. (-नः)
A name of ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun.
E.
अश्मन् stone, अण् affix: immoveable as a stone, having no legs.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Made of stone, consisting of stone, &c.
E.
अश्मन् and ठक्.
